text:
Symbioen monitors and verifies the performance of public and private EV chargers. 

Measuring charging performance is difficult because every operator defines it differently. Symbioen measures this gap between what operators claim and what chargers actually deliver — leaving customers overcharged, investors working from inflated figures, and procurement teams unable to compare numbers across networks.

To close that gap, Symbioen provides EV charging KPIs that use open regulatory data as a shared baseline. Any network, operator, or region can then be compared against the same baseline. 


For operators, Symbioen offers independent proof of network performance in front of customers, partners, and procurement teams. Investors and public bodies need comparable, objective data too: due diligence and portfolio monitoring as well as cross-regional performance tracking — site hosts and EV fleets draw on the open data to compare operators against the same standard, while Symbioen's reporting — spanning site-level and regional data — offers performance figures for both site and regional scope. 


For questions, partnerships, or access to public or private reports, reach out at vadim@symbioen.com or visit symbioen.com.
